metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1968 · 2001: A Space Odyssey
metas.description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two humans and one supercomputer is sent to Jupiter to find its origins.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1968 · Planet of the Apes
metas.description: After being kept in hypersleep during a long expedition into deep space, an astronaut crew crash-lands in the 40th century on a planet where highly intelligent non-human ape species are dominant and humans are enslaved.
